body:
By changing the scripted field syntax from:
`doc['utc_time'].value.getMillis()`
to 
`doc['utc_time'].value.toEpochMilli()`

I managed to get the scripted field to evaluate correctly. 

Can you confirm if this is the expected way from now on? Or are you planning on re-introducing `getMillis`?

getMillis() was a method provided by the Joda library. It has been deprecated since 6.x, and the compatibility layer with Joda was just removed for 8.0 (#78417).  So this change was intentional. 

You should have been getting deprecation warnings. Can you confirm Kibana was getting these?

Deprecation warnings as in through the code or through a channel of communication? I am not sure, to be honest.

Before we close this, should a breaking change also be listed here:
https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/pull/78417/files#diff-33c7b553eb513d4b1ed286c3494ed756aff0f82923e60f16909f1db068ff26b5R20

?

> Deprecation warnings as in through the code or through a channel of communication

Deprecation logs in Elasticsearch, and/or doesn't Kibana look at warning headers? It should have been there as well.

>  should a breaking change also be listed here:

Yes, we will add the removed methods to the breaking changes.
I merged a change to Discover. Feel free to close once you update the breaking section of the docs.
